name: Palram Industries (1990) Ltd
summary: Palram Industries (1990) Ltd operates as a manufacturer of extruded thermoplastic sheets and panel systems in Israel and internationally. It offers commercial and residential corrugated, flat, and multiwall sheets; panel systems; accessories; and construction and architecture, agriculture, sign and display, safety and security, industrial fabrication, and home and outdoor living solutions. The company also engages in the development, production, and sale of self-assembly products for the home environment, such as greenhouses, warehouses, gazebo pergolas, parking lots, etc. In addition, it offers sales points and display stands. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Zevulun, Israel.…
